Game Overview

In BBQ Stack Run, the core idea is straightforward: dive into BBQ Stack Run, where you sprint through zany parkour, collecting meats and spices. Outsmart spinning blades and hammers, then sell perfect BBQs to earn rewards. Customize your look and push your BBQ stacking skills to new heights in this deliciously fun challenge.
